[page[title]]

A 204 No Content response must not include response content.

What the Standard says

RFC 9110 states that a 204 response is terminated by the end of its header section and cannot contain content. Read section 15.3.5.

Why it matters

Sending a representation with 204 gives clients contradictory framing semantics and can cause intermediaries or generated clients to discard or misinterpret the payload.

Bad code example

[HttpDelete]
public IActionResult Delete(int key) =>
    StatusCode(statusCode: 204, value: deletedModel);

Good code example

[HttpDelete]
public IActionResult Delete(int key) =>
    NoContent();
